full_judgment:
Mr. A. K. Badrul Haque, J:- One Haji Md. Yusuf in the capacity of Informant as petitioner on presentation of this petition seeks to be added as opposite party in Criminal Miscellaneous Case and also seeks cancellation of anticipatory bail granted to accused A. Kader (Mobile Kader) the petitioner of Criminal Miscellaneous Case No. 7616 of 2001 and opposite party No. 1 in the petition taking ground that he was not made opposite party in the Miscellaneous case and on practicing fraud upon Court obtained ad-interim anticipatory bail. 

 2. In the Criminal Miscellaneous Case the State is opposite party No. 1. 

 3. A private party or the prosecutor here, the Informant as a matter of right cannot be heard and added as party in criminal proceeding though initiated at the instance of Informant but the Court can in its discretion hear the party in sup-port or in opposition of the Criminal proceeding before a court of law. We, thus, allow the Informant to render assistance to this Court through his learned Lawyer with learned Attorney General or Deputy Attorney General or Assistant Attorney General representing the State at the time of hearing of the Miscellaneous Case. 

 4. This takes us to the prayer for cancellation of ad-interim anticipatory bail granted to accused-petitioner of Criminal Miscellaneous Case at the time of issuance of Rule. 

 5. In anticipation of arrest the accused-petitioner of Criminal Miscellaneous Case in invoking jurisdiction under Section 498 of The Code of Criminal Procedure approached this Court for anticipatory bail. This Court while issuing Rule granted ad-interim anticipatory bail for a period of Three (3) months by order dated 30.10.2001. Anticipatory bail is granted under special circumstances and it is granted at a stage when the investigation is incomplete and it is not informed about the nature of evidence against the alleged offender. Anticipatory bail is of a limited duration and ordinarily on the expiry of that duration or extended duration the court granting anticipatory bail is to lave it to the regular court to deal with the matter on appreciation of evidences placed before it after the investigation had made progress or charge sheet is laid. The regular court then has to consider whether having regard to the material placed before it the accused person is entitled to bail.
